moments.title: Taylor Swift Dominates UK Charts
moments.blurb: Taylor Swift achieves a UK chart double for the second consecutive week, with 'Patient Zero' at number one on the singles chart and 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' topping the albums chart.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Queen of the charts! Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is still number one in the UK for a second week, while 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore' holds the album top spot. Unstoppable. #TaylorSwift

angles.name: Triple Threat
angles.copy: Not one, not two, but three! Taylor Swift is the first artist to score three UK number one singles in 2026. Currently, 'Patient Zero' leads the pack. What a year for Tay Tay! #ChartTopper

angles.name: Album Power
angles.copy: Still spinning 'The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore'? So is the UK! Taylor Swift's album is back at number one for its fifth non-consecutive week. Which track is your fave? #AlbumChart

moments.title: Blossoms Top Album Chart
moments.blurb: Stockport indie-pop band Blossoms have debuted at number one on the UK Official Albums Chart with their new album 'Songs from the Wedding Cake'.

angles.name: Indie Kings
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Blossoms! Their new album 'Songs from the Wedding Cake' has stormed straight to number one on the UK Albums Chart. Get it on repeat! #Blossoms

angles.name: Local Pride
angles.copy: Stockport's finest doing us proud! Blossoms' 'Songs from the Wedding Cake' is the new UK number one album. What a triumph for the lads! #Stockport #NewMusic

angles.copy: What a week for England! Dominant wins over Croatia (7-0) and Czechia (3-0) in the Nations League. Are we seeing the next generation shine? #England #ThreeLions
